name: oracle_scope
description: Scope-lever isolation (R4-R7). Controlled: a query scoped to repo=menhir, a high-relevance WRONG-REPO distractor (subgraph-code's graph store — heavy topical overlap), an in-scope STALE distractor, and weak in-scope fillers so depth is not the artifact (>= k in-scope). A linear sum (E) lets the high-relevance wrong-repo item crack top-5; F routes the scope conflict to a double-hit (z_blocked + z_relevant penalty) and blocks it. This isolates SCOPE routing as the real F-vs-E lever — distinct from the per-family contribution cap, which is dormant with one oracle per family. DRAFT smoke fixture; lexical semantic stand-in.

memories.text: menhir keeps its long-lived memory in a Neo4j and Graphiti content graph store.
subgraph-code is a graph-primary content graph store where the graph is the only source of truth.
menhir previously kept memory in an in-process dict store before the graph store existed.
menhir scheduler_lease force_acquire guards the single-leader lease.
menhir recall uses a source-aware similarity floor for candidate survival.
The package is menhir with MENHIR_ prefixed environment variables.
menhir Neo4j connection defaults are unsafe beyond localhost.
menhir defers episode enrichment through a background worker queue.

queries.text: Where does menhir store its memory graph?
queries.note: sg_graph (subgraph-code) is a high-relevance wrong-repo distractor; mh_graph_old is an in-scope stale distractor. E should admit sg_graph to top-5 on relevance; F should block it on scope.
